body:
Founder's queue-btn still failed after the prior fix: greyed-out button, silent 'connection closed' ~10s later, no ERROR code. Root-caused live: (1) IDUNA's 3-signups/IP/24h guest cap was exhausted from repeated founder retries, so bootstrapAccount() kept failing and the client connected with an empty token; (2) the server's HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS(10s) path in expire_timers() called conn_close() directly with no ERROR frame -- silent, on every client. Fixed: expire_timers() now send_error(DW_ERR_AUTH) before closing; main.ts logs bootstrap failures into the visible #log panel. Live-verified against production both ways (tokenless connect -> ERROR code 2 at 10s; real token -> WELCOME->ready->QUEUED). Server + web client redeployed. Reset the founder's own exhausted signup counters. commit 7c834a2.

⚓ ☃
title: Third matchmaking bug: silent auth-timeout close + exhausted signup cap, both fixed
